raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Conflated recyclability with renewability—incorrectly labeling aluminum as “renewable” due to high recyclability and dismissing trees as non-renewable. By standard definitions, trees are a renewable resource (they regrow on human timescales with sustainable management), while aluminum is non-renewable (extracted from finite bauxite) though recyclable.
